# Average American Credit Card Debt [2026]
> Last updated: 2026-09-25

> Average American credit card debt by state, age, income, and household. 2026 statistics from Federal Reserve and Census data, with US averages

## About
averagecreditcarddebt.org is part of the Open Bankruptcy Project (openbankruptcyproject.org), a 501(c)(3) nonprofit building free, open-source tools for bankruptcy court transparency.
